macros.name: eqframebox
macros.doc: \eqframebox provides an automatic-width analogue to LaTeX’s \framebox. It takes the same arguments as \framebox with the same default values for the optional arguments.

macros.name: eqframebox
macros.doc: \eqframebox provides an automatic-width analogue to LaTeX’s \framebox. It takes the same arguments as \framebox with the same default values for the optional arguments.

macros.name: eqmakebox
macros.doc: Like \makebox, \eqmakebox supports the “s” (stretch) value for the ⟨pos⟩ argument, which causes the ⟨text⟩ argument to stretch to the width of the box.

macros.name: eqmakebox

macros.name: eqsetmaxwidth
macros.doc: The \eqsetmaxwidth macro accepts a tag and a length and records that the user wants the associated box to be no wider than the given length.

macros.name: eqsetmaxwidthto
macros.doc: The \eqsetmaxwidthto macro accepts a tag and a piece of text and records that the user wants the associated box to be no wider than the text, typeset at its natural width.
